en: Colorized photograph of a war memorial set along a tree-lined path in a park or cemetery. At the center is a stone statue of a soldier in uniform, bowing his head, with several figures at the base, mounted on a pedestal surrounded by flowers. On both sides are long stone walls or tablets inscribed with many names. The image has a cream border, and at the bottom in cursive script it reads the location and the title of the monument in German.
